"Ichi chikamu chechinyorwa chakadhindwa mupepanhau rechikoro (nhamba dzemitsetse dzinotanga pa 1).
1) Our school should ban phones from the building.
2) Last month, Mina got a new phone, and her math score dropped from 90 to 75.
3) So phones clearly make all students' grades worse.
4) Also, phones are noisy in the hallway, and some students look up answers during tests.
5) Therefore, the school should ban them for everyone."

x-e-h1-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 ndiwo dambudziko. Kutaura kuti zvibodzwa zvichaipa "chokwadi" kwe "vadzidzi vose" kubva pakudzikira kwechibodzwa chomudzidzi mumwe chete (mutsetse 2) mhedziso huru kupfuura humbowo. Kudzikira kwechibodzwa kunogona kuva nezvimwe zvikonzero, senge kuoma kweongororo kana mamiriro. Mutsetse 4 unopa chikonzero chakasiyana nezvibodzwa (ruzha, kubiridzira), saka unofanira kufungwa zvakasiyana kubva padambudziko iri. "Banned for everyone" mumutsetse 5 inovakirwawo pamhedziso iyi, asi panotanga dambudziko ndiwo mutsetse 3.

x-e-h1-01.s.s2.r.c: Izvi zvinounganidza mamiriro akawanda erudzi rumwe chete. Hazvidzivisi zvimwe zvikonzero zvokuti sei zvibodzwa zvevadzidzi ivavo zvakadzikira.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.r.d: Kuti mafoni anoshandiswa sei mukirasi hazviratidzi zvakananga hukama nezvibodzwa.
x-e-h1-01.s.s2.explain: Kana ukaenzanisa vadzidzi vane mafoni nevasina mafoni panguva imwe chete, unogona kuyera kana tsananguro ye 'nokuda kwemafoni' iri nani kupfuura zvimwe zvikonzero. Kuunganidza mamiriro akawanda kana kubvunza pfungwa kunoita kuti chirevo chinzwike chakasimba chete.
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.prompt: Nyora patsva mutsetse 3 kuti uenderane nehumbowo huri mumutsetse 2 (mitsara 1-2 yeChirungu), uye unyorewo kuti data rakawanda rinodikanwa kutarisa chirevo.
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mutsara wawakanyora haudi zvakawandisa kupfuura ruzivo rwuri mumutsetse 2 (mudzidzi mumwe) here?
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Nedata rawakatumidza, unogona kuenzanisa ne 'mamiriro asina foni' here?
x-e-h1-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Mutsara unoratidza kuti pangava nezvimwe zvikonzero here?

x-e-h1-04.s.s2.explain: Zvinoreva hazvisarudzwi namashoko chete asi nokuti mashoko anoenderana namamiriro here. Kana mashoko akanaka asi mamiriro akaipa, unogona kufungira zvinoreva zvakavanzika.

x-e-h1-05.title: 'I have a test' kuramba here kana kwete?
x-e-h1-05.goal: Rongedza kuti ruzivo rupi rwunodikanwa kutonga zvinoreva mhinduro isingataure zvakananga (kana iri kuramba), uye unyore meseji inobvunza pasina kukonzera kusanzwisisana.
x-e-h1-05.material:
"Aya mameseji pakati paJin naHana.

Jin: Are you coming to the study group tonight?
Hana: I have a huge test tomorrow.
Jin: So is that a no?
Hana: Haha, I don't know yet."
x-e-h1-05.thinking.0: Kuona kuti zvinoreva zvakavanzika hazvisarudzwi sechimwe chete chete
x-e-h1-05.thinking.1: Kusiyanisa ruzivo rwunodiwa pakutonga neruzivo rusingadiwi
x-e-h1-05.prereq.0: Kuverenga mameseji mapfupi eChirungu padanho regiredhi rekutanga rehigh school
x-e-h1-05.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwezuva nezuva rwekuti mhinduro inogona kusapindura mubvunzo zvakananga
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza zvose zvaunofanira kuziva zvakawanda kuti utonge kana Hana ari kuuya.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira nyaya imwe apo mhinduro yaHana ichireva 'handigoni kuenda' neimwe apo ichireva 'ndichaenda'.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga musarudzo ruzivo runosiyanisa nyaya mbiri idzi.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.r.b: Nguva yetest haina hukama hwakananga nekuuya kwaHana.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.r.d: Huwandu hwevanhu hahushandiswi zvakananga mukutonga kusarudza kwaHana.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.explain: Mashoko aHana angareva 'handigoni kuenda nekuda kwetest', kana 'ndichaenda kuti ndidzidzire test'. Saka unofanira kuziva kana boka riri retest imwechete, uye kuti Hana munhu akadini kana achidzidza.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.acc.0: Chinangwa cheboka ndiro ruzivo rwakakosha zvikuru pakutonga. Zvakanakazve kutarisawo tsika dzaHana dzekudzidza.
x-e-h1-05.s.s1.acc.1: Tsika dzekudzidza dzakakosha, asi unofanirawo kutarisa kana boka riri retest imwechete.
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.prompt: Semunhu anonzi Jin, nyora meseji muChirungu yekutumira kuna Hana (mitsara 1-3). Mamiriro: taura nezve test/kudzidza, isa mubvunzo mumwe kana kupfuura waanogona kupindura pasina kumanikidzwa, uye upe pfungwa kana sarudzo dzekudzidza pamwe chete.
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.hint.0: Funga nzira mbiri dzingasarudzwa naHana (uya udzidze, dzidza kumba).
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.hint.1: Edza chimiro che 'Do you want to ...?' kana 'If you ..., we could ...'.
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Meseji inopa Hana mukana wekusarudza pasina kumudzvinyirira here?
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakabvunza nenzira inobvumira mamiriro kuchinja zvichienderana nemhinduro yaHana here?
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Inobvunza kana kuudza chaizvo ruzivo rwawakasarudza mu nhanho 1 here?
x-e-h1-05.s.s2.modelNote.1: Yakabvunza kana ndiyo test imwechete uye yakawedzera mamiriro.

x-e-h1-07.title: Bike lane itsva yakaderedza ngozi chaizvo here?
x-e-h1-07.goal: Sezvo uchapupu huchiwedzerwa humwe humwe, ongorora zvakare kuti chirevo chinonyengetedza zvakadini, uye utsanangure nezvikonzero kuti nhamba ipi inogadzirisa dambudziko.
x-e-h1-07.material: Ichi chirevo chinobva munyaya yedhorobha. "The new bike lane made our street safer." Verenga zviratidzo nenhevedzano.
x-e-h1-07.thinking.2: Kusasvika pamhedziso kubva pachidimbu chimwe chouchapupu
x-e-h1-07.prereq.0: Kuverenga nyaya pfupi yeChirungu padanho regiredhi rekutanga rehigh school
x-e-h1-07.prereq.1: Kunzwisisa kwezuva nezuva kwakakwana kusiyanisa 'rate' ne 'count'
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.prompt: Nguva imwe neimwe wotaura chiratidzo, tonga kuti chirevo chinotsigirwa zvakadini.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa kana chiratidzo chitsva chichipa chimwe chikonzero chingatsanangura nhamba yekare.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.hint.1: Siyanisa kana nhamba iri 'zviitiko zvingani' kana 'zviitiko zvingani pavanhu vangani'.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kubva pachiratidzo ichi chete, chirevo chinotsigirwa zvakadini?
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.after: Zvishoma kupfuura mwedzi wakafanana gore rapfuura zvinonongedzera nzira imwechete nechirevo, asi mwedzi mumwe chete.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Zviratidzo zvishoma zvikuru kuti titarwe nenhamba yemwedzi mumwe.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Chinotsigirwa kusvika padanho, asi mwedzi mumwe chete, saka tinofanira kutarisa zvakare.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Tarisa chiratidzo chitsva ichi uchinje kutonga kwako pamusoro pechirevo.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.after: Haugoni kuziva kana ngozi dzakaderera nekuda kwemugwagwa kana nekuti vanhu vashoma vakakwira mabhasikoro apo kwaiva kunaya.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Chirevo chakaneta. Ngozi dzingadai dzakaderera nekuti vanhu vashoma vakakwira mabhasikoro.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kana vanhu vashoma vachikwira, ngozi dzinogonawo kuderera.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Zvino zvakaratidzwa kuti chirevo chiri chenhema.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Chakangoneta; hachisi uchapupu hwekuti chiri chenhema.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Verenga kusvika pachiratidzo chekupedzisira uye upfupise kutonga kwako.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Nguva yakareba, uye kunyange nhamba yevakwira yakawedzera, rate yengozi yakaderera, saka kushaya simba kwekutanga kwakagadziriswa. Zvisinei, haugoni kutaura kuti hapana chimwe chikonzero zvachose.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kuenzanisa kunofunga nguva yegore rimwe nenhamba yevakwira kwakawedzerwa.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Zvakaratidzwa kuti mugwagwa ndiwo chikonzero chete.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Data iyi haigoni kukuudza kuti chikonzero 'ndechimwe chete'.
x-e-h1-07.s.s1.reflect: Pachiratidzo chipi kutenda kwako kwakachinja zvakanyanya? Taura chikonzero mumutsara mumwe.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.prompt: Nei 'ngozi pavakwira 1,000' mu nhanho 3 ichigadzirisa dambudziko re nhanho 2 zvirinani?
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.hint.0: Rangarira kuti chii nezvenhamba yengozi chaiva dambudziko mu nhanho 2.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.o.a: Nekuti inoita kuti nhamba yengozi iite hombe, saka inoonekwa
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.r.a: Nhamba inoita hombe nekuenzanisa kwakaenzana zvinhu zvakasiyana.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.r.b: Ndiwo mutemo wekuverenga wakachinja; hazvirevi kuti ngozi dzakawanda dzinoverengwa.
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.o.c: Nekuti unogona kuenzanisa zvakaenzana kunyange nhamba yevakwira ichichinja
x-e-h1-07.s.s2.explain: Kana ukaenzanisa nhamba chete, haugoni kuziva kana ngozi dzakaderera nekuda kwemugwagwa apo vanhu vashoma vakakwira. Kana ukachinja kuita ngozi pavanhu 1,000, unogona kuderedza mhedzisiro yenhamba yevanhu uye kuenzanisa.

x-e-h1-08.title: Zvinyorwa zviviri zvinopokana chaizvo here?
x-e-h1-08.goal: Tsvaga mutsara usina kururama mupfupiso yezvinyorwa zviviri uye uugadzirise, wosarudza danho rinotevera rekugadzirisa kupokana.
x-e-h1-08.material:
Izvi zvinyorwa zviviri nepfupiso yemudzidzi (nhamba dzemitsara yepfupiso dzinotanga ne 1).

Source A (city news, March 3): "The Hanbit Library reopened on March 1 after repairs. It now opens seven days a week, and about 300 people visited on the first day."
Source B (library blog, March 5): "We reopened on March 2. We are open six days a week, closed on Mondays. More than 300 visitors came on our first day!"
x-e-h1-08.prereq.0: Kuverenga nhau pfupi nezvinyorwa zveblog zveChirungu padanho regiredhi rekutanga rehigh school
x-e-h1-08.prereq.1: Kunzwisisa kwezuva nezuva kwenhamba kwakakwana kutonga kana 'about 300' ne 'more than 300' zvichigona kuenderana
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe usina kururama mupfupiso yemudzidzi. (Kunyange mitsara miviri kana kupfuura isina kururama, unongoda kusarudza imwe chete.)
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.hint.0: Kune mutsara mumwe nemumwe, nyora nhamba kana mazuva ezvinyorwa zviviri padivi pemumwe.
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.hint.1: Edza rimwe rimwe kana nhamba mbiri dzingaita dzechokwadi panguva imwechete.
x-e-h1-08.s.s1.explain: Mitsara 3 ne5 ndiyo dambudziko. 'about 300' ne 'more than 300' dzose dzinogona kuva dzechokwadi, saka nhamba yevashanyi haisi kupokana (mutsara 3). Mutsara 5 unotaura kuti chimwe chinyorwa hachina kururama, asi haugoni kuziva kubva pachinyorwa ichi oga kuti ndechipi chisina kururama. Kupokana mumitsara 2 ne4 kwechokwadi.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.prompt: Fungidzira kuti mutsara upfupiso unoenzanisa nhamba dzevashanyi dzezvinyorwa zviviri hauna kururama, uye ugadzirise mutsara uyu, uchinyora mumitsara 1 kana 2 yeChirungu. Isanganisira kuti nhamba dzevashanyi dzezvinyorwa zviviri dzine hukama hwakadini.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.hint.0: Kopa zvakanyatsojeka kuti chinyorwa chimwe nechimwe chiri kutaura sei nhamba yevashanyi.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora kuti 'about' ne 'more than' imwe neimwe inotsanangura renji renhamba ripi.
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Zvinoonekwa here kuti 'about 300' ne 'more than 300' zvinogona kuva zvechokwadi pamwe chete?
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora mazita ezvinyorwa zviviri (Source A/B) kana mashoko azvo zvakanyatsojeka here?
x-e-h1-08.s.s2.modelNote.2: Yakaratidza nenhamba chaiyo (310) kuti zviviri zvinogona kuva zvechokwadi pamwe chete.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.prompt: Danho rinotevera rakanakisisa rekutsvaga kuti zuva rekuvhura raiva March 1 kana 2 nderipi?
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.hint.0: Funga kuti zvinyorwa zviviri zvingadai zvakavakirwa paruzivo rupi.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.hint.1: Funga chinyorwa chechitatu chaunogona kutarisa usati watenda divi rimwe.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.o.a: Source B yakanyorwa pazuva rakazoitwa gare gare, saka tevera B pasina kutarisa zvakaparadzana.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.r.a: Kuti chinyorwa chakanyorwa gare gare hakureve oga kuti zuva rakarurama. Unoda uchapupu hwakatarisa zuva zvakananga.
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.o.b: Tsvaga uye utarise rekodhi rezuva rakaitwa pazuva rekuvhura (senge chiziviso).
x-e-h1-08.s.s3.explain: Kuti uone kuti nei mazuva akasiyana, unoda uchapupu hwakananga, senge rekodhi rakaitwa pazuva iroro. Nguva yekunyora kana huwandu hwevaverengi oga haugoni kukuudza kuti divi ripi rakarurama.

x-e-h1-10.title: Kugadzira kutaurirana kunoramba kukokwa uchichengeta hukama
x-e-h1-10.topic: Kunyora mhinduro kana kutaurirana kunogutsa mamiriro
x-e-h1-10.goal: Nyora iwe pachako kutaurirana pfupi kweChirungu kunogutsa mamiriro ose (kuramba kwakajeka, chikonzero, imwe sarudzo, nekunzwisisa kwemumwe munhu).
x-e-h1-10.material: Shamwari A inokoka B kuenda kuconcert pamwe chete na 7 p.m. musi weSaturday. B ine chiitiko chemhuri manheru iwayo uye haagoni kuenda.
x-e-h1-10.prereq.0: Kuverenga nekunyora kutaurirana pfupi kweChirungu padanho regiredhi rekutanga rehigh school
x-e-h1-10.prereq.1: Mazwi ekutanga anoshandiswa kana usingagone kugamuchira kukokwa
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.prompt: Nzira yakakodzera zvikuru yekuti B aramba i ipi?
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa kana A, mushure mekunzwa mhinduro imwe neimwe, achigona kuziva 'kana B anogona kuenda kana kwete'.
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.r.a: Yakajeka, asi toni inozvidza kukokwa kwemumwe munhu.
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.r.c: "I'll try" haijeki kana i kuramba kana kugamuchira, saka zvakaoma kuti mumwe aronge.
x-e-h1-10.s.s1.explain: Kana pane kuramba kwakajeka (can't), chikonzero, uye imwe nzira (zuva rakasiyana) pamwe chete, mumwe haanzwisisi zvisirizvo uye haakuvadzwi zvakanyanya. Mhinduro isingajeki inoita kuti mumwe amirire, uye kutaura kwakaoma zvakanyanya kunoremedza hukama.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.prompt:
Gadzira nhaurirano pakati paA naB muChirungu. Tanga mutsetse wega wega ne A: kana B:, uye unyore mitsetse 4 kana kupfuura.
Mamiriro 1) B anotaura zvakajeka kuti haagone kuenda (can't, nezvimwewo).
Mamiriro 2) B anopa chikonzero.
Mamiriro 3) B anokurudzira zuva rakasiyana kana nzira yakasiyana.
Mamiriro 4) A anoratidza maitiro ekunzwisisa.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza chikonzero (chiitiko chemhuri, nezvimwewo) nenzira imwe (zuva rakasiyana) kutanga, wobva waronga kurongeka kwemitsetse.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora kurongeka mumhinduro yekutanga yaB: isa 'kutenda', wobva washandisa can't.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Kuramba kwaB kwakajeka here, kana kusingajeki sa 'try to come'?
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Imwe nzira i kukurudzira kunogona kuitwa chaizvo (pane zuva kana nzira) here?
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.modelNote.1: Yakagutsa mamiriro akafanana kunyangwe mamiriro akachinjwa.
